How to read this register

Section link

A supplied workbook entry, an inspected certificate copy and a live government registry match are different evidence levels. Current live HFR status was not queried. Workbook RS flags are reproduced as supplied; their meaning is undefined and they do not establish operational or HFR status.

The source workbook contains 37 ACTIVE and 15 INACTIVE values under an undefined RS column. They are preserved as source flags, with no assumption about registration validity or whether a centre is open. Addresses and postcode columns are reproduced separately where the workbook supplies both; confirm the current premises with Pinnacle.

Tirupati IN2810065148 appears in the workbook. The additional original certificate IN2810053847 is kept separately. The source material does not establish that either replaces or cancels the other.

Sources: All Centers With HFR.xlsx, sheet All Centers With HFR, rows 2–53. Recognitions bundle, physical pages 67–95. The workbook has no date column; 18 September is the inspection date.
